tei:div.tei:p: "!#'u'u'u: pad+ma'i zhal gdams rtsa gsum mthong ba rang grol las: gshin rje'i yang zlog spu gri reg gcod bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ log 'dren srin po'i tshogs rnams kha gnon la: pad 'byung nga ni rnga yab gling du 'gro: ma 'ongs bod khams 'gro ba gdul dka' yang: nga yi rig 'dzin sangs rgyas kun gyi sras: 'gro ba 'dul phyir ma nges snang tshul can: 'od zer ming can snying po'i dgongs don 'dzin: mthong thos skyes bu don dang ldan na yang: gus par mi 'dun 'gran sems log rtog mang: dus kyi dbang gis skye brgyud bar chad che: gzhan skyon rigs ldan phyag rgyas gsol mi 'debs: bar chad ngang rgyud ring ba'i dbang song na: glang stag gnyis la skye ba 'pho nyen che: bod khams bdud sprul rgyal bsen 'byung pos gang: 'gro la gnod pa 'byung bzhi'i nad slong zhing: lus sems 'khrugs pas 'khrul pa sna tshogs 'char: 'on kyang nga yi rjes 'jug las smon can: sku gsung thugs gter zab mo'i sgo 'byed pas: dus babs dbang gis phan pa dpag med kyang: log rtog skye bo'i bar chad du ma 'byung: bden pa'i lugs bzhin de la 'dud gyur na: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈphyi rabs kun: rkyen ngan dgra bgegs srog la rgol ba dang: dpon slob dam sel snying po'i bstan la gnod: de dag sgrol phyir zlog sngags spu gri bzhag: ma 'ongs snying la chongs shig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gang du gnas shing sgrub pa'i sa phyogs der: gnam lcags ur mo gru gsum gcig tu bsgom: de las me yi tshwa tshwa thog ltar 'phros: byad ma lha srung skad cig bsregs par bsam: de yi phyi rim gnam lcags 'khor lo yi: rtsibs stong ldan pas dgra bgegs hrug hrug bcad: gshin rje ma mo bdud srin sprin bzhin 'khrigs: de yi phyi rim rdo rje mtshon cha dang: 'byung lnga'i srung 'khor spu gri reg gcod ltar: phyi rol 'khor bas dgra bgegs thul bar bsam: ur mo'i nang du khro chu khol ma'i dbus: pad+ma nyi mar gshin rje chu glang gdan: de steng rang nyid gshin rje'i rgyal po ni:

sku mdog mthing nag ral gri gdengs pa can: dur khrod chas brgyad phyag g.yas ral gri dang: g.yon pas sdigs mdzub lcags kyus dgra bgegs 'gugs: bzlas pas rang gi snying gar pad nyi'i steng: gnam lcags ral gri bsnol ma g.yon 'khor bas: dpa' bo gri khrag dgra bor bsams nas mid: skad cig sha khrag dmar thor song ba la: gsang gnas 'khor lor gshin rje ma mo'i tshogs: hab hab zos pas lhag mar rngams dung bsam: e ka du na zlog: ma hā du na zlog: sa ga du na zlog: ra tsa du na zlog: suṃ tri rak+sha du na zlog: ma hā rak+sha du na zlog: oṃ a kro te ka shrī mañju ya ma rā tsa zlog: oṃ ti sgyur thi khrom bha la ya ci zlog: oṃ badz+ra gha ling ka zlog: che ge la bh+yo: ya ma ru tra tsa sha da ra sa: byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i srog la mā ra ya rbad rbad: rtsa la rgyug rgyug: snying la myog myog: mā ra ya rbad: lho'am nub kyi phyogs su kha gtad nas: bzla tshe lce nyid gnam lcags so gnyis bsam: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dgong dus gong gi srung 'khor gsal bzhin du: ri rab rtse ru bdag nyid yod par bsam: bang rim bzhi pa'i steng nas gza' bdud ni: shin tu 'jigs shing mi sdug gzugs kyi kha: gnam sa tsam gdangs mche gtsigs mig stong 'khyugs: gnod byed 'byung lus rbad rbad 'phangs pa la: rngams rngams tshul gyi 'ub kyis zos par bsam: thal brdab dgra yi phyogs su rbad pa 'am: yang na rgya mtsho'i klong du thim par bsam: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnod byed gdon la gnan pa bya ba ni: sāts+tsha nag po rten 'brel med pa gcig: gru gsum nang du ling ga gnod byed gzugs: rid cing skem la nyam thag lcags sgrog bcug: de yi snying gar drag po'i rtsa sngags bri: bskyed rim ldan pas dgug gzhug yang yang bya: phyin ka log dril sāts+tsha'i nang du gzhug: rdo rje rgya gram bris pas zhabs bsdam mo: mal 'og gru gsum sāts+tsha mgo log gzhug:

ro g.yam rgya gram bris la dong kha bcad: de nyid ri rab mos byas mnan par bsam: de steng 'jam byas rang gi mal bca' 'o: brgyud ldan bskyed rdzogs brtan pos mnan par bsam: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: byad zlog gshin rje rgol du med pa 'di: pha rol yang zlog mkhan gyi gshed ma yin: spu gri reg chod gshin rje log sngags 'di: bai ro khyod dang lha sras ma gtogs pa: rje 'bangs 'khor ni su la'ang bstan pa med: da lta ma spel rin chen gter du sbos: 'di nyid rgyas pa ka ba bzhi la yod: 'bring po dbang phyug gnas su sbas pa 'o: bod khams 'gong zhugs nang zhig 'byung ba'i dus: mtha' dmag dbus lud bod khams 'joms la nye: dus la bab bo snying la sa ma ya: chos min spyod cing gser srang stong byin yang: 'di nyid spel tsho nga yi dam las 'das: thog mar ma spel lo gsum bar du sbos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gab rgya: 'od gsal sna tshogs rang grol gyi gter ma'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
